defects.claim: Wrap both arms loosely around the raised shin
defects.evidence: Both arms overhead: L shoulder abducted 128°, R shoulder abducted 163°; elbows above shoulders; wrists at y=0.99 (L) and y=1.22 (R) — far above raised shin midpoint y≈0.27. PR-v4 comment confirms shoulders were forced to -110 (overhead) as auto-fix too-subtle, but description requires forward shin-wrap not overhead. left_shoulder_flexion -158° and right_shoulder_flexion -148° both outside plausibility band [-60,180].

failing_tests.name: arms_should_wrap_raised_shin
failing_tests.assert: leftWrist.y < 0.40 AND rightWrist.y < 0.40 AND left_arm.shoulder_abduction_deg < 50 AND right_arm.shoulder_abduction_deg < 50

regression_risk: Low — only arm fields changed. Legs (L hip flexion 120°, L knee 109° = raised knee; R leg extended), torso (24° forward lean), pelvis all preserved. No contact/regression expected beyond arm re-positioning.
rationale: PR-v4 auto-fix blindly scaled shoulders to -110 (overhead) for a pose whose description requires wrapping arms around the raised shin (forward+down contact, not overhead). Same defect class as cross-ankle-sit critical fix from batch 1. Revert: drop shoulder abduction -110→-20 (brings arms from overhead to ~30° abducted, lateral-low); flip shoulderFwd from +25 (behind per corrected convention) to -20 (forward, reaching shin); keep elbow ~95° (right-angle for forearm to wrap shin). Sign convention verified: shoulderFwd + = BEHIND, - = FORWARD. Expected post-fix: wrists drop from y~1.0 to y~0.30 (shin level). Torso lean toward raised L knee preserved (lateral flexion -5° = lean figure-left toward L knee).
